description: This file contains test specifications for functions related to resolving and expanding user home directories, environment variables, and related path manipulations within a Node.js project, using the Vitest testing framework.

methods.name: resolveEffectiveHomeDir
methods.description: Resolves the effective home directory based on environment variables and an optional homedir function.

methods.name: resolveRequiredHomeDir
methods.description: Resolves the required home directory, defaulting to current working directory if none specified.

methods.name: resolveOsHomeDir
methods.description: Resolves the OS-specific home directory, prioritizing environment variables.

methods.name: expandHomePrefix
methods.description: Expands a path prefix with tilde (~) into a full path based on provided home directory sources.

methods.name: resolveHomeRelativePath
methods.description: Resolves a relative path, expanding tilde paths using the specified home source or fallback to cwd.

methods.name: resolveOsHomeRelativePath
methods.description: Resolves a path relative to the OS-specific home directory, expanding tilde paths accordingly.
